en: A monochrome, early 20th‑century style image showing a very large crowd of men gathered in front of a long, two‑story building with arched windows. Many are wearing traditional Eastern European or Balkan rural clothing (sheepskin coats, caps, boots) while some are in military uniforms. Numerous horse‑drawn wagons with canvas covers stand in the foreground, and the scene appears to be a mass assembly or mobilization in a town square.
